correctness.rationale: Independently verified the proof: decompose N[G]=U∪V, intersection equals G as one-dimensional complex of cycle rank n(n−2)−2n+1=n²−4n+1. Each U,V collapses onto Alexander dual of Ind(disjoint projected C_m). Classical three-periodic cycle formula gives reduced homology in h with rank 2^c, and full 2-skeleton for n≥7 ensures simply connected; Whitehead/Hurewicz gives each side wedge2^c S^h. Null maps from connected graph W into simply connected U,V yield homotopy pushout U∨V∨ΣW. Independently enumerated and checked examples partitions (7),(3,4),(9),(3,6),(3,3,3), finding predicted F2 Betti pairs; finite tests corroborate, unrestricted proof is the symbolic pushout/duality argument.
